PLUGIN_HOSTD_GROUPING_REASONS.doc: Why a member of a plan is not in a segment with its neighbours, or is in one on an assumption (the grouping-planner design note, The planner), in the order the planner's rules decide them. plan_get answers them as instance:reason; a plan_reason event carries the same. A controller reads these words and retypes none.

refused.doc: The pin's verdict is refused: the plugin is not run in a group, and an add of it answers -516.

noPin.doc: The plugin has no pin and pin_mode is strict: an add of it answers -508.

noVerdict.doc: The pin carries no verdict (a pin the daemon learned on first use): the plugin stays alone.

verdictIsolated.doc: The pin's verdict is isolated: the plugin stays alone.

formatWorld.doc: The plugin's format pins only in a world of its own and no world holding the plugin can be built for a shared worker: it stays alone.

historyCrashed.doc: The history marks the plugin as crashed on this host class, a crash within the last 30 days, or the supervisor has quarantined it now: the plugin stays alone.

historyXruns.doc: The history marks the plugin as raising xruns when grouped, its share of xrun windows in a group over its share alone by the margin after enough windows: the plugin stays alone.

costOver.doc: The plugin's cost, alone, is over group_cost_max: it stays alone.

formatMixed.doc: No one worker program runs this plugin together with the open segment: it starts a new segment.

groupFull.doc: The open segment holds group_max members: the plugin starts a new segment.

groupCost.doc: Adding the plugin's cost takes the open segment over group_cost_max: it starts a new segment.

costAssumed.doc: The plugin has no known cost and joined a segment at the median of the known costs of that segment, zero when none is known.

noNeighbour.doc: The plugin passed every rule but has no neighbour it can share a worker with: it is alone only because of the members around it.

groupingOff.doc: The setting grouping is off: the plugin would share a worker, and the plan was answered and not applied.

historyUnavailable.doc: The history cannot be read, its file is blocked or history_window_s is 0: the plan was made from the pins and the costs alone, as for a plugin with no history, and this plugin had nothing harder to say.

planRefused.doc: A segment could not be formed: the plan was not applied and nothing moved. The word is followed by a colon and the number of the refusal, plan-refused:-501.

PLUGIN_HOSTD_GROUPING_REASON_GROUPS.doc: The property every reason of PLUGIN_HOSTD_GROUPING_REASONS declares (its group): whether a later plan may answer otherwise with the chain unchanged. A client that asks again reads the reasons of the group retry from here and chooses none in code.

retry.doc: A later plan may not give this reason again with the chain as it is: a pin may gain a verdict, what refused a segment may pass. A controller may ask again.

final.doc: The reason holds while the chain, the pins, the history and the settings are as they are: asking again gives it again.
